Regionalization by inverse distance weighting (C2)

Source: R/regionalize-methods.R
ef_method_idw.Rd

Describes configuration C2-IDW for ef_regionalize() and ef_regionalize_cv() (dev/specs/gwr-forcing.md section 5.4): $$\hat y(x) = \sum_j \lambda_j y_j, \qquad \lambda_j = \frac{d(x, j)^{-q}}{\sum_k d(x, k)^{-q}},$$ with q = power, without covariates; at a location that coincides with stations, the mean of their values (the limit of the formula).

Usage

ef_method_idw(power)

Arguments

power

Positive number, no default (the usual choice 2 is not verified): the power q. A vector of several values is a registered grid from which q is selected for every fit by leave-one-out cross-validation (smallest CV; ties to the smallest q).

Value

A list of class "earthflux_regionalization_method" with method = "idw".

Details

Distances are Euclidean in the projected CRS of the grid, divided internally by the largest distance between the stations of the fit (which does not change the weights). Errors: earthflux_missing_input (power), earthflux_input_error (not numeric, duplicated values), earthflux_domain_error (q <= 0 or infinite).

Verification status

CANDIDATA: Shepard (1968) is cited by the specification but was not read.

References

Shepard, D. (1968). A two-dimensional interpolation function for irregularly-spaced data. Proceedings of the 1968 23rd ACM National Conference, 517-524. doi:10.1145/800186.810616

See also

Other spatial regionalization functions: ef_gwr_bandwidth(), ef_gwr_diagnostics(), ef_gwr_fit(), ef_gwr_predict(), ef_gwr_search(), ef_method_gwr(), ef_method_ols(), ef_method_station(), ef_predict_control(), ef_regionalize(), ef_regionalize_cv(), ef_spatial_folds()

Examples

ef_method_idw(2)
#> <earthflux_regionalization_method> idw 
#> power 2
ef_method_idw(c(1, 2, 3))
#> <earthflux_regionalization_method> idw 
#> power selected by LOOCV in {1, 2, 3}
